summary: 28-year-old female fell from standing height at Timberline Falls (~2 p.m. request); self-evacuated with help from park visitors; 2-person park hasty team met her below Loch Lake with micro spikes and trekking poles and assisted her to near Glacier Gorge Trailhead by ~7:15 p.m.; self-transported to Estes Park Health
location: Timberline Falls / Loch Lake, Rocky Mountain National Park
notes: RMNP News Release June-4-2021 via the Rocky Mountain Day Hikes June-2021 archive (opened 2026-09-13); one of two same-day Loch Vale-area snow-fall incidents (see 2021-06-01 32-YOM Loch Vale row).
